notes.friday_close: close of the h1 bar starting Fri 20:00 UTC (NYSE close) for stocks / ETFs / NAS100; 21:00 UTC for metals and oil (CME 17:00 ET); bar timestamps are bar starts
notes.drift: 100 ln(Bybit perp last at 21:01 UTC / CFD Friday close)
notes.GOOG: CFD is class C (GOOG); the Bybit perp is class A (GOOGL): small share-class spread
notes.WTI / BRENT: CFD cash prices; the Bybit CL / BZ perps track a futures index, so a basis is expected
